tool.name: datav-list-component-types
tool.description:
List all registered panel/screen component types available for authoring a big screen.
Returns a JSON object with a "components" array. Each component descriptor contains: - type: component type identifier (use as componentType in datav-generate-screen) - displayName: human-readable component name - needsDataset: whether this component requires a dataset binding (true for chart/table/stat-tile/pivot-table/map; false for text/iframe/container and all decorative/media types) - configAreas: list of named configuration areas the component accepts (name, description, required)
Big screens can use ALL 14 component types (including decorative/media types like decorative-border, scroll-text, time-clock, video, stream, carousel-tab), unlike dashboards which only support 8 types.
Use this tool first to understand what component types are available before designing the screen layout.
